title: The Late Postcard
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
